**Why it crashed outside the chart:** The allergy form was only wired for the patient chart. Its chart wrapper reads the patient from the chart's workspace group, `groupProps?.patient` and `groupProps?.patientUuid` (`openmrs-esm-patient-chart/packages/esm-patient-allergies-app/src/allergies/allergies-form/allergy-form.workspace.tsx:616-634`). In the fill-prescription flow, the order basket runs outside the chart, so no chart group props exist. The form was launched as the `patient-chart` group with null props, and the buttons registered to that group crashed with `Cannot read properties of null (reading 'patientUuid')`. The PR descriptions report this error, but the pre-fix code is not in the checkout, so I did not confirm the exact crash line myself.

**What is launched instead:** The dispensing app registers `dispensing-order-basket-add-allergy-workspace` in `fill-prescription-window`, pointing at `exportedAllergyFormWorkspace` (`openmrs-esm-dispensing-app/src/routes.json:115-119`). The fill-prescription button passes that name as `allergyFormWorkspaceName` in the order basket props (`openmrs-esm-dispensing-app/src/fill-prescription/fill-prescription-button.component.tsx:42-50`). The exported variant takes `patient` and `patientUuid` from window props instead of the chart group (`openmrs-esm-patient-chart/packages/esm-patient-allergies-app/src/allergies/allergies-form/exported-allergy-form.workspace.tsx:17-31`, registered in `openmrs-esm-patient-chart/packages/esm-patient-allergies-app/src/index.ts:37-42`). The add-drug-order workspace uses the host-provided launcher, so inside the chart behaviour is unchanged (`openmrs-esm-patient-chart/packages/esm-patient-medications-app/src/add-drug-order/exported-add-drug-order.workspace.tsx:17-36`).

**The fix:** The dispensing change is PR #854, "(fix) O3-5734: Allow recording allergies from the fill prescription order basket", merged 2026-06-11 (commit `120d22e968d57a1ce47a5a908e50e79f485cfcb1`). It is the only one of the three PRs that links a ticket, O3-5734. It depends on the chart PR #3353 (commit `160e8d0bc956f1e4d774a4a7f1047c06b8f18fda`), which added the exported workspace and the optional launcher. The ward app got the same wiring in PR #2561 (commit `3368e9e64bc85e1bd55b6ba25a3d31537c167f82`), which links no ticket.
